name: Bounced PDCs
query: SELECT name AS "PDC:Link/PDC:160", payment_entry AS "Payment Entry:Link/Payment Entry:180", customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180", cheque_no AS "Cheque No:Data:140", amount AS "Amount:Currency:120", cleared_amount AS "Cleared:Currency:120", (amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0)) AS "Remaining:Currency:120", reference_date AS "Reference Date:Date:120", bounced_reason AS "Bounced Reason:Data:220", bounce_charges AS "Bounce Charges:Currency:120", bounce_charges_invoice AS "Bounce Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:160", replacement_pdc AS "Replacement PDC:Link/PDC:160", pdc_status AS "Status:Data:140" FROM `tabPDC` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND pdc_status IN ('Bounced', 'Partially Bounced') ORDER BY reference_date DESC, modified DESC
